newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb wounds two civilians in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds two civilians in south Lebanon.

text.p: A Lebanese civilian and a policeman were wounded on Wednesday when a bomb went off near their car inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
The blast occurred as policeman Tanios Habib and civilian Samih Mezher were driving on the Bkassin road in Jizzine. Both were taken to hospital, the sources said.
The 15-km (nine-mile) wide occupation area is a battle zone where Lebanon's Hizbollah guerrillas often attack Israeli troops and their local militia allies with the aim of driving them out.
